name: Shipment to Stormwind
summary: William Pestle sends a parcel from Goldshire to his brother in Stormwind. Its candles carry wax gathered from kobolds in Elwynn Forest to Morgan at Pestle's Apothecary.

sections.title: A Family Trade
sections.body: William Pestle gathers herbs, reagents, and raw goods in Goldshire. His brother Morgan runs Pestle's Apothecary in Stormwind's Trade District. William cannot easily leave the Lion's Pride Inn, so he trusts travelers bound for the city to carry his goods.

sections.title: From Kobold Wax to Capital Potions
sections.body: William's parcel holds large candles gathered from kobolds in Elwynn's mines. He collects them for their wax, but does not say how the brothers use it. You carry the shipment to Morgan at Pestle's Apothecary in the Trade District.

faq.answer: The shipment contains candles gathered from kobolds in Elwynn Forest. William collected them for their wax and packed them for Morgan at Pestle's Apothecary.

faq.q: Where do I find Morgan Pestle?
faq.answer: Morgan Pestle works inside Pestle's Apothecary in Stormwind City's Trade District, a short walk past the main gates.

faq.q: How are William and Morgan Pestle related?
faq.answer: William and Morgan Pestle are brothers who run an alchemical enterprise together. William gathers materials in Elwynn Forest, while Morgan runs their shop in Stormwind.

faq.q: Why doesn't William deliver the package himself?
aliases: why doesn't william go to stormwind
faq.answer: William is occupied with his trade and gathering alchemical ingredients in Goldshire. He relies on travelers already heading toward the capital to carry the package.

faq.q: Do kobold candles have an actual alchemical use?
faq.answer: William says he and his brother need the candles for their wax. He does not explain how they use it at the apothecary.

faq.q: What comes after delivering the shipment?
aliases: what next after shipment to stormwind
follow up quest shipment to stormwind
faq.answer: Delivering the shipment ends the short chain that began with gathering kobold candles in Elwynn Forest. Morgan pays you for carrying the parcel and welcomes your business in his shop.

angles.text: The Pestle family trade depends on local reagents from Elwynn. Their Stormwind shop is a familiar stop for gatherers and potion-makers.
As an Alliance champion, you carry supplies along the king's road into Stormwind, traveling from countryside skirmishes toward the capital.
